breakdown.description: Output requests solution at T=1.1 but the Domain section specifies t in [0, 1].
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt specified a time domain of t in [0, 1.0] but asked for an output at T=1.1. The agent correctly identified this conflict and, in alignment with the ground truth, set the final time to T=1.0 throughout the generated specification, making it consistent with the defined domain.
